properties.entry: What the editor tells of its cleaning

Paste into the editor below, from the field above or from any page: the cleaning in the browser leaves out what the editor does not take, and the server hears what the paste lost, a notification; with Tell what a paste lost, the editor says it under its toolbar too. The server cleans again whatever comes. Send the HTML from anywhere as the text of the editor, as a request made by hand would, past the cleaning in the browser: the server cleans it silently, tells what it removed, or rejects the text, as chosen.
